clause: Tables: creation, import, structure, and flow [STU-LAY-035:creation/import/setup/structure/flow/nesting]

scope.summary: Implement the table object as a structured object flowed inside a StudioTextStory (cell content is text, graphics, or nested tables), reusing the foundation table storage (MT-004) — never a forked table model. Creation: insert-table with body/header/footer row counts, column count, optional table style; draw-table tool; convert text<->table with selectable row/column separators. Import: spreadsheet import (sheet/view/cell-range as formatted/unformatted table or tabbed text), word-processor tables (retain or strip formatting, optionally kept linked). Table setup: border stroke, spacing before/after, stroke draw order, header/footer counts. Structure: insert/delete/select rows and columns, merge/unmerge, split horizontally/vertically, distribute evenly, paste before/after, drag-duplicate, sort. Flow: break across threaded frames and pages with repeating headers/footers; go-to-row incl header/footer. Nesting & alignment: nested tables in a cell; table alignment left/center/right within the frame column. Field-level model owned by 14.23; cell formatting/styles in MT-167.
acceptance_criteria: table object flowed in StudioTextStory with creation/import/setup/structure/flow/nesting; reuses foundation storage
proof_targets: table create/structure/flow runtime; import + nesting test
expected_tests: live: insert-table/draw-table/convert text<->table; structure ops (insert/delete/merge/split/distribute/sort); flow breaks across threaded frames with repeating headers
test: spreadsheet + WP table import (formatted/unformatted/linked); nested tables + table alignment

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Tables (create, import, structure, flow)

risk_if_missed: No tables; tabular data cannot be laid out; long tables cannot flow across pages.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
